description: Takes blanket or limit purchase orders (order, value, called off so far, start, end; optional supplier and open invoices not yet booked). Returns per order the remaining budget, the share used, the use per month, the day the budget is expected to run out compared with the end of the term, invoices that are not covered, a traffic light and the next step (top up, renegotiate, framework contract instead of an order, follow-up order). Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: Blanket orders: order, supplier, value, called_off, open_invoices, start, end. German column names work too (Bestellung, Wert, Abgerufen, Offene Rechnungen, Beginn, Ende).

name: check_blanket_orders
title: Blanket order guard: remaining budget, monthly use, the day the budget runs out and invoices without cover
